messages:
Priya: kicking off rollout v2.4.0 -> us-central, initial traffic 10% across chat & gen routes. deploy-bot: rollout started (id=5893) at 1741005432, routes=[chat-route, gen-route], traffic=10%

Leo: watching p99 and error budget. @Nikhil can you watch chat-route p99?

Nikhil: watching dashboard https://console.redwood/slo/chat-route — p99 just jumped from 320ms to 620ms across a few hosts.

SLO-alert-bot: [ALERT] chat-route p99 > 500ms (620ms)  severity=critical  window=1m

Priya: yikes. Any 5xxs?

Nikhil: 5xx stable ~0.1% but latency spike correlated with one edge pod repeatedly GC'ing. logs: ```2026-03-21T13:07:01Z warn: heap growth triggering full-gc, pod=chat-srv-7```.

Leo: could be a memory regression in v2.4.0 runtime. Suggest PAUSE rollout and pin chat-route back to v2.3.5 to avoid user impact. Thoughts?

Priya: agree. Pause and pin. We don't need a full rollback if only chat-route affected. Nikhil, run `deployctl pause --rollout=5893` and then pin.

Nikhil: running commands now: `deployctl pause --rollout=5893` -> success. `deployctl pin --route=chat-route --version=v2.3.5 --reason='p99-surge-during-canary'` -> success. chat-route traffic reverted at 1741005480.

deploy-bot: rollout 5893 paused at 1741005475. chat-route pinned to v2.3.5 at 1741005480. gen-route remains on v2.4.0 at 10% traffic.

Priya: opening a short incident ticket and adding note to release notes PR. release-notes-bot: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pulls/332 updated with: "Paused chat-route canary and pinned to v2.3.5 after p99 latency spike; investigating memory/regression in runtime."

SLO-alert-bot: subscribing eng-runtime, eng-ml, oncall to incident-5893 channel.

Leo: can eng-runtime grab heap dumps and flamegraphs from the GC-ing pod? Nikhil please collect and upload.

Nikhil: heapdump + flamegraphs uploaded: https://s3.redwood/5893/heapdump-1741005490.hprof , https://s3.redwood/5893/flame-1741005502.svg . initial read: increased allocation in TokenBuffer::append in v2.4.0 path.

Priya: ok. eng-runtime and eng-ml prioritize a patch. We will hold chat-route until metric stable for 15m and a patch is validated. Keeping gen-route canary running.

Leo: noted. I'll add a short summary for PG: "Canary paused for chat-route due to p99 regression; pinned to stable; gen-route continuing; RCA in progress."

Priya: thanks. Closing thread for now, will re-open with debug updates.
